edits.after: Source-certified syntax capability consolidation: for syntax checking use this existing evaluate tool with validate_only=true; use the expression unchanged. This mode calls the same native parser and returns the same syntax result as the retired model-facing validate_syntax capability on its valid argument domain, without numerical evaluation. The former allow_variables/detailed options did not add their advertised semantic controls in the released handler. Syntax acceptance is not evaluation or verification of Python runtime/security. The ordinary evaluate mode remains available with validate_only=false. Invalid argument diagnostics are not claimed equivalent.
